arg.replaceable: show [PAGE] | add-ip IP REASON | add-ip-range START END REASON | remove-entry ID

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Requires C/blacklist and confirmed internal GUID authentication for players. Saves entries in g_vpnBlockerDBPath. Ranges include both endpoints. Show displays eight entries per page. Reasons contain 1 to 100 printable bytes. Authenticated exemptions and IP whitelist rules override blacklist rules. Enforcement requires g_vpnBlockerEnabled 1 and uses g_vpnBlockerBanMessageBlacklist. Changes re-evaluate connected players.
